Note that the dzongkhag reports and the national report do not agree everywhere: the twenty come to 720,837 against the 727,145 the national report analyses, itself 8,408 short of the 735,553 found in the country once non-Bhutanese in hotels are counted. The figure here is the dzongkhag's own, which its gewogs add up to exactly. This is the gewog's own count. Towns and thromdes are enumerated beside the gewogs rather than inside them and the boundary file draws none of them, so a dzongkhag's gewogs come to less than the dzongkhag itself by its urban population -- 37.8% of Bhutan nationally, and named on the dzongkhag's record.
